title: Two-minute walk test reference equations for healthy adults and the elderly
author: He Zou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.quqdwvw
materials: Appropriate shoes for walking should be worn.

steps.title: Prepare the testing environment
steps.instruction: Set up a 30 m walking course in a long, flat, straight, enclosed corridor with a hard surface that is seldom traveled (or outdoors if weather is comfortable).

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Ensure the following items are available at the testing site:

substeps.instruction: Two small cones to mark turnaround points

steps.title: Verify subject preparation
steps.instruction: Confirm the subject has met the following pre-test requirements:

substeps.instruction: No vigorous exercise within 2 hours of the test
Light meal acceptable if test is early morning or early afternoon

steps.title: Conduct pre-test resting period
steps.instruction: Have the subject sit at rest in a chair near the starting position for at least 10 minutes before the test starts.

substeps.instruction: Verify appropriateness of clothing and shoes

steps.title: Perform the two-minute walk test
steps.instruction: Instruct the subject to walk up and down the corridor as fast as possible for two minutes.

substeps.instruction: Position the subject and the operator at the starting line
Start the timer as soon as the subject begins walking
Provide standardized encouragement ('you are doing well; you have one minutes left') after 60 seconds

steps.title: Record and calculate distance
steps.instruction: Determine the total distance walked by the subject.

substeps.instruction: Record the number of laps from the counter or worksheet tick marks
Record the additional distance covered in the final partial lap using wall markers as guides
Calculate total distance walked, rounding to the nearest meter, and record on the worksheet

steps.title: Complete the session
steps.instruction: Congratulate the subject on their effort and offer a drink of water.
